summary_en: ¥95/share annual dividend (¥65 prior forecast): interim ¥50 (+67%), terminal ¥45 (+29%). Payout ratio 40%+ or DOE 1.0%+ policy maintained. Rationale: FY2027.3 earnings upgrade (net income +¥700M to ¥2,650M, +35.9%), driven by offset ink, functional ink/gravure ink, and mobility-use chemical product strength despite material-cost inflation.
title_en: Notice regarding revision of consolidated earnings forecast for Q2 (interim) and full year FY2027.3 (March 2027) and revision of dividend forecast (dividend increase)
translation_en_brief: Tokyo Printing Ink on 5 August 2026 issued a notice revising its FY2027.3 (year ending 31 March 2027) consolidated earnings and dividend forecasts upward. Earnings: mid-term net income revised to ¥1,400M (from ¥800M, +75%), full-year to ¥2,650M (from ¥1,950M, +35.9%). Dividend: annual dividend raised to ¥95/share from ¥65/share (+46.2%), comprising interim ¥50/share (from ¥30, +67%) and terminal ¥45/share (from ¥35, +29%). The company maintains its capital policy framework balancing capital efficiency, financial strength, and shareholder returns, targeting a payout ratio of 40%+ or dividend-on-equity of 1.0%+. Upside driven by strong performance in offset ink sales, functional ink and gravure ink for medical packaging, and mobility-use chemical products, offsetting raw material cost inflation and supplier pricing revisions.
